pipelineInvariant: Source Record -> Company Event -> Company State Change -> Signal Episode -> Commercial Thesis -> External Agency Propensity -> Agency DNA Match -> Opportunity -> Actionable Lead

contracts.requirement: One ordinary vacancy does not create an actionable opportunity.

evidence.testName: does not turn ordinary vacancy volume into an episode without a state change
does not qualify an ordinary event without a confirmed state change

contracts.requirement: Duplicate publications of one vacancy do not increase vacancy count or score.

evidence.testName: deduplicates one vacancy across sources and preserves every publication
counts the same canonical vacancy from two publications once

contracts.requirement: Four ordinary vacancies at a baseline of four do not create a strong episode.

evidence.testName: does not classify four ordinary vacancies as acceleration for a company whose own baseline is four

contracts.requirement: Four vacancies can create an episode when they strongly exceed a low company baseline.

evidence.testName: detects a company-specific acceleration when four vacancies strongly exceed a low baseline
creates a baseline-aware acceleration episode for the same four vacancies

contracts.requirement: A new CTO without hiring evidence remains context rather than a lead.

evidence.testName: keeps a new CTO as context when hiring evidence has not changed

contracts.requirement: A new CTO plus technical hiring acceleration creates one combined episode.

evidence.testName: combines a CTO change and technical acceleration into one episode

contracts.requirement: A strong episode without Agency DNA Match does not become a lead.

evidence.testName: does not build a candidate when no Agency DNA Match exists

contracts.requirement: A strong opportunity without a contact path is queued for enrichment.

evidence.testName: keeps strong quality without a contact path and queues enrichment
persists and replays a quality candidate without contact suppression

contracts.requirement: Low External Agency Propensity cannot receive a qualified status.

evidence.testName: keeps low external propensity out of qualified statuses

contracts.requirement: An existing client becomes a Grow opportunity.

evidence.testName: supports Find, Grow, and Reactivate without merging their identity

contracts.requirement: A former client becomes a Reactivate opportunity.

evidence.testName: supports Find, Grow, and Reactivate without merging their identity

contracts.requirement: Do-not-contact always blocks commercial action.

evidence.testName: blocks commercial action for %s regardless of other scores

contracts.requirement: New negative evidence can lower a previously high score.

evidence.testName: is reproducible and changes the input hash for negative evidence

contracts.requirement: A model input change creates a reproducible immutable scoring generation.

evidence.testName: allocates a new immutable generation for a changed evidence input
previews, applies, no-ops, and advances only after upstream Agency DNA refresh

contracts.requirement: Repeated ingestion is idempotent.

evidence.testName: stays dark unless the flag is exactly true and replays idempotently

contracts.requirement: Feedback from one workspace cannot change another workspace.

evidence.testName: keeps feedback from one workspace out of another workspace plan
rejects cross-tenant provenance and append-only mutation

contracts.requirement: Query-plan exclusions remain tenant and profile scoped.

evidence.testName: does not union one profile exclusions or feedback into another profile
rejects cross-tenant provenance and append-only mutation

contracts.requirement: A stale episode expires and leaves qualified output.

evidence.testName: expires current scoring when the source episode is no longer active
builds a stale situation as expired instead of reviving it

contracts.requirement: Untrusted LLM text cannot change score or status.

evidence.testName: ignores untrusted LLM text when calculating score and status
keeps an expired situation auditable without claiming urgency

contracts.requirement: Every evidence-based reason contains real evidence IDs.

evidence.testName: binds every evidence-based reason to real input evidence IDs
uses episode evidence for derived claims but not for declared unknowns
